 Judgment

The plaintiff has filed this suit for declaration to declare that the he is absolute owner in possession of the suit property and sale deed dated 25.06.2005 is void & not binding on the plaintiff, and consequential relief of mandatory injunction against the defendant.
The suit property is non-agriculture land.

2. The averments made in the plaint in brief as under ;-
a.

That, it is specifically averred in the plaint that plaintiff is owner in possession of Site No.20 Khata No.28 situated at Laggere village, Yeshwantapur Hobli measuring E-W 30 feet N-S 40 and building therein.

The plaintiff submits that his father G. Raju had purchased the suit property as per registered sale deed dated 20.03.1980 and he died instate leaving behind him plaintiff -son and Vedavalli mother of plaintiff as his legal heir.
It is specifically pleaded that on 09.12.1999 mother of plaintiff Vedavalli executed registered release deed in favour of plaintiff, relinquishing her rights in the schedule property.

The plaintiff submits that in view of death of G. Raju and execution of release by Vadavalli mother of plaintiff, he has become the absolute owner in possession of the suit property and he is residing in the suit property along with his family members.
b. It is further pleaded that plaintiff came to know that defendant in connivance with some unknown person has created sale deed in his favour which is also registered on 25.06.2005.
It is further pleaded that by impersonating the plaintiff sale deed has been created and photo shows that fictious person impersonating the plaintiff has executed the document.

The plaintiff submits that he has filed complaint before jurisdictional police, & criminal case came to be registered at Cr.No.120 of 2006 and after Investigation charge sheet is also filed for the offence punishable under sec.419, 468,
420 R/w sec. 34 of IPC before VIII ACMM at C.C.No.5506 of 2012.
The plaintiff submits defendant absconded and trial is yet to complete.
The plaintiff submit that since sale deed is fraudulent transaction, there is no need to challenge the sale deed and in view of pendency of criminal case he has waited for cancellation of sale deed.

c. The plaintiff submits some real estate agents have visited the suit property saying that Siddeshwara has informed that house is for sale and on 15.01.2021 once again some people have visited suit property saying that property is for sale.

The plaintiff submits that though sale deed is fraudulent, it need to recorded in the books of sub- registrar and as such he has filed this suit for Ravi vs Siddeshwarappa on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33419768/
2 declaration to declare that he is the absolute owner in possession of the suit property and consequential relief of mandatory injunction.
3. In response to the summons issued the defendant has not appeared and he is place ex-parte.
4.

On the basis of pleading, oral & documentary evidence, following point arose for my consideration :
1.
Whether the plaintiff proves that he is the absolute owner in possession of the suit property ?
2. Whether plaintiff proves that sale deed dated 25.06.2005 is created by impersonating the plaintiff and is fraudulent document?
3. Whether plaintiff is entitled for the relief of declaration and mandatory injunction as prayed ?
4. What order or decree?

6. Heard counsel for plaintiff, perused available documents and my findings on above points are as under :-
 Point No.1: In the Affirmative  Point No.2: In the Affirmative  Point No.3: Plaintiff is entitled for the relief of declaration and mandatory injunction Point No.4: As per final order, for the following:-
REASONS 7. Point No.1: That, the plaintiff has filed this suit for declaration to declare that he is absolute owner in possession of the suit property and to declare that sale deed dated 25.06.2005 is fraudulent document & not binding on him.
As a consequential relief the plaintiff has sought mandatory injunction directing Sub-Registrar to cancel the sale deed in Book-I maintained under the provisions of Registration Act.
8. In order to succeed in this suit the plaintiff has to establish that he is absolute owner in possession of the suit property and sale deed dated 25.06.2005 is fraudulent document.
To prove the case pleaded, the plaintiff got himself as PW-1 and produced 20 documents.
PW-1 has reproduced contents of plaint in examination in chief.
Pw-1 is not subjected to cross examination as defendant has not appeared & contested the suit.

sentences.text: I have perused the documents produced by the plaintiff in detail.
Ex-P1 Original Sale deed dated 20.03.1980.
It is clear from Ex-P1 that G. Raju S/o Govindaraju has purchased the suit property from one Iramuttaiah @ Irappa and others for a consideration amount of .1000/-.
So it is clear that G. Raju is the owner and purchaser of site No.20 formed in Sy.No.28 of Laggare village.
10. I have perused Ex-P2 release deed dated 09.12.1999 in detail.
Ex-P2 is executed by one Vedavalli in favour of plaintiff herein.

It is mentioned in Ex-P2 that G. Raju died on 12.10.1994 leaving behind him wife- Vedavalli and son- R. Ravi as his legal heir and Vedavalli has relinquished her right in the suit property in favour of the plaintiff.
Ex-P2 is duly executed and registered in the office of Sub-Registrar Bangalore North.

So it is clear from Ex-P2 that original owner G Raju died and in view of release of share, plaintiff who is son of G. Raju has become absolute owner of the suit property.
11.
I have perused other documents produced by the plaintiff which shows that there exist a house to which plaintiff has taken electricity and water connection.
Therefore, in my opinion the plaintiff by producing original sale deed and released deed plaintiff is able to show that he is the owner in possession of the suit property.
Accordingly point No.1 is answered in the affrimative.
12. Point No.2:- This point is framed regarding contention taken by the plaintiff that sale deed dated 26.05.2005 is created by impersonating him and as such same is void.
In order to establish the contention plaintiff is relying upon Ex-P3 charge sheet filed in CC 5506 of 2012 and Ex-P4 Sale deed dated 26.05.2005.
I have perused Ex-P4 certified copy of Sale deed dated 26.05.2005 in detail.
It is mentioned in the sale deed that plaintiff has executed sale deed in favour of the defendant.

On perusal of Photo and signature along with Ex-P11 PAN card, Ex-P12 Election Identity card, it is clear that plaintiff is not the person who has executed the document and someone else by impersonating the plaintiff has executed Ex-P4 sale deed.
Plaintiff has produced original title deed pertaining to suit property which shows that he is son of G. Raju original purchaser of the suit property.
On the face of record impersonation can be inferred by this court.

Apart from this in criminal case the investigation officer after verifying the documents and getting FSL report has filed charge sheet for the offence punishable under section 419, 468, 420 R/w sec. 34 of IPC against defendant and others.
Therefore in my opinion plaintiff is able to establish that sale deed dated 26.05.2005 is forged document created by impersonating the plaintiff.
Accordingly this point is answered in the Affirmative.
13. Point No.3:
This point is framed with respect to entitlement of relief claimed by the plaintiff.

While answering point No.1 and 2 I have concluded that plaintiff is absolute owner in possession of the suit property and sale deed dated 26.05.2005 is created and fraudulent document on face of record.
Hence declaration that plaintiff is absolute owner in possession of the suit property and sale deed dated 26.05.2005 is void documents can be granted in favour of the plaintiff.
In fact the plaintiff need not seek cancellation of sale deed as it is forged, fraudulent document, not valid and non-est in the eyes of law.

14. The plaintiff has claimed relief of mandatory injunction directing the Sub-Registrar to cancel the registration of the sale deed dated 26.05.2005 in the books maintained by Sub-Registrar's office.

sentences.text: Since sale deed dtt 26.05.2005 is fraudulent and forged document, same is to be cancelled by declaring that sale deed dated 26.05.2005 is void.
After such declaration it is necessary to direct the Sub-Registrar to make an entry in the books to the effect that sale deed dated 26.05.2005 is declared as void by competent Civil Court.
Therefore, in my considered opinion, the plaintiff is entitled for relief of mandatory injunction also.
There is no impediment to grant reliefs claimed.
Accordingly I answer this point holding that plaintiff is entitled for the relief claimed.
15. Point No.4:-
In view of discussion and conclusion made at point Nos. 1 to 3, suit is liable to be decreed.
Hence following:-
ORDER The suit of the plaintiff is decreed with cost.
It is ordered and declared that plaintiff is the absolute owner in possession of suit property.
it is further ordered and declared that sale deed dated 26.05.2005 is null and void and not binding upon the plaintiff.

It is further ordered and decreed that mandatory injunction is issued directing the Sub-Registrar, Bangalore North , to make an entry in the Books maintained by registering authority regarding declaration made by this Court to the effect that sale deed dated 26.05.2005 is null and void.
Draw decree accordingly.
(Dictated to the Stenographer Grade-I, transcript thereof corrected and then pronounced by me, in open Court, on this the 14 th day of August, 2024.)

(BHAT MANJUNATH NARAYAN) XLIII Addl.
City Civil & Sessions Judge, Bengaluru ANNEXURE I.
